about: Scorecard targets (data/targets.json) that count as compromised for a decision kernel trained on wild choice records. data/targets.json is frozen and carries no such mark; reports apply this list through src/rw/manifest.ts (compromisedFor, flagCompromised) for a kernel whose manifest names the label source below. A kernel that is only scored on wild choices is not marked. Registration: docs/staging/rw-prereg.md section 9 (overlaps A and B) and docs/staging/rw-bench-prereg.md section 7.
decision: User, 6 October 2026 (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, Track R, item 3): "Mark the five overlapping targets as compromised for field-trained engines."

targets.overlap: B: the same focal protocol and males, 1998-2007, probably the same records (mitani2009)
targets.reason: Male bond persistence was measured on the grooming and proximity of these males in these years; a kernel trained to reproduce these males' partner choices is taught the answer.
